visual.title: From a plane to a bowl
visual.caption: The tangent plane is the linear model. Adding the Hessian term bends it into a quadratic that matches the curvature, which is the second-order Taylor model.

predict.question: The quadratic term of the second-order model comes from:
predict.explain: f(x0 + h) ≈ f + ∇f·h + ½hᵀHh. The Hessian H supplies the quadratic term that the tangent plane omits.
